description: AI-agent platform for building, testing, deploying, and governing custom agents across models, apps, APIs, and business workflows.

evidence.finding: MindStudio lets users bring their own model API keys, choose among more than 200 models, control model and third-party service access, and configure collaborator permissions and usage budgets.

MindStudio's terms state that users may stop using the service and request account termination, while the platform's pricing describes exportable logs and configurable retention controls for business use.
MindStudio publishes plan prices, usage terms, model-access options, activity logs, analytics, and budget controls so users can inspect cost and operational behavior.
MindStudio explicitly supports human-in-the-loop checkpoints where agents pause for human approval or revision before sensitive actions continue.
MindStudio provides a free plan with one agent and 1,000 runs per month, plus a low-cost individual tier and self-paced learning resources for users evaluating the platform.
MindStudio states that user data is never used for training and its privacy policy provides access, correction, deletion, restriction, and portability rights where applicable.

MindStudio supports bring-your-own API keys, access to more than 200 models, third-party APIs, webhooks, Node.js, Zapier, Make, n8n, and custom code, reducing dependency on a single model or integration path.
MindStudio says users can see exact model and workflow costs without markup on API calls, with real-time cost tracking and budget controls.
MindStudio supports collaborators with granular permissions, user-level access controls, role-based access, activity history, and team-oriented deployment controls.
MindStudio's human-in-the-loop design allows agents to prepare actions and then pause for human review, preserving human judgment for sensitive or consequential steps.
MindStudio offers a free tier, no-code agent creation, no API key requirement for routed models, and extensive self-paced training materials.

limitations: This preliminary audit uses public MindStudio primary-source documentation and has not been reviewed by MindStudio.
Published product documentation is evidence of documented controls and policies, not proof of real-world outcomes for every deployment.
Humanity Score is a product-impact rating, not a regulatory, legal, safety, compliance, or government certification.
correction_policy: Source-backed factual corrections are welcome. Corrections change the audit only when the underlying evidence changes; payment cannot buy a higher score.
